card.name: LIB-FIX-08 — Refuse backup restore during deck preparation
card.description:
## Reproduced restore admission defect — 3 November 2026
Actual temporary Cue → AudioEngine.start held at resume has processing=true, playing=false and no playQueued flag. Existing backup guard admitted that state. Actual restore file-input handler then replaced track title/crates and reached saving during pending Cue. RED is retained; not an observed musical pop or unexpected-start cause.

## Bounded repair / acceptance
- [x] Existing restore guard now includes d.processing; message asks to wait for preparation. No Cue cancellation, new state machine, DSP or layout change.
- [x] Actual Cue/AudioEngine/restore handler regression RED→GREEN with controlled resume/clock/graph. Rejected restore leaves whole session byte-identical, persistence empty and pending Cue processing/start token unchanged.
- [x] Cleanup cancels Cue/pauses before releasing held resume; processing=false/playing=false/voices0 asserted. Eight current restore tests pass, including invalid/legacy backups and LIB-FIX-07 gain restore. Only new cleanup assertion rechecked separately; no broad suite.
- [ ] Include both restore repairs in desktop139 and inspect exact archive.
- [ ] Native isolated admission/restore acceptance; source evidence does not establish native or musical behavior.

Scope: pending deck preparation only. Other sampler/preparation breadth is not established by this regression. Controls/layouts/source and library waveform renderers untouched. Original media/current138 saved session untouched; audio muted. Related LIB-011, LIB-FIX-07 and DEK-015. Distinct from restore during pending import and from applying already-restored master gains.
Evidence https://github.com/jpoindexter/open-play/blob/codex/core-four-deck-trace/docs/prototype/LIBRARY_RESTORE_PREPARING_2026-11-03.json
Primary Codex gpt-6.1-sol/high; parent Claude alternative recommendations remain subject to availability. No agent invocation implied.
